name: Florida
agencyName: Florida Department of Highway Safety and Motor Vehicles

subRequirements.note: 10 of the 50 questions cover road signs; there is no separate road-sign minimum, only the overall 40/50 (80%) passing score.

retake.retakeFee: Retest fee (approximately $10) may apply for repeat attempts

gdl.nightCurfew: Age 16: no driving 11 p.m.-6 a.m.; age 17: no driving 1 a.m.-5 a.m., unless driving to/from work or with a licensed driver 21 or older

requiredDocuments: Primary identification (e.g. U.S. birth certificate or passport)
Two documents proving Florida residential address
4-hour Traffic Law and Substance Abuse Education (TLSAE) course completion (applicants under 18)
process.realIdNotes: Florida licenses are REAL ID compliant. Bring proof of identity, proof of Social Security Number, and two proofs of residential address.
process.licenseFee: $48 (Class E original); tax collector offices may add up to a $6.25 service fee
process.visionStandard: 20/40 or better in each eye, with or without corrective lenses

facts.pointSuspensionThreshold: 12 points in 12 months (30-day suspension), 18 points in 18 months (3-month suspension), or 24 points in 36 months (1-year suspension)
facts.moveOverRule: Move over one lane, or slow to 20 mph below the posted limit, for stopped law enforcement, emergency, tow, utility, and sanitation vehicles with flashing lights
facts.schoolZoneSpeed: 20 mph when the school-zone signal is flashing or the reduced limit is posted
namedLaws: Florida Ban on Texting While Driving Law
Hands-free requirement in school and work zones
